Standard: The rotary-wing air vehicle is capable of jettisoning external loads without incurring damage to the airframe or resulting in loss of control. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the air vehicle is capable of jettisoning external loads without loss of control or incurring damage to the air vehicle for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. External loadings should include the minimum and maximum combinations of weight and sling/pendant length approved for service. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle is capable of jettisoning external loads without loss of control or incurring damage to the air vehicle for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. External loadings should include the minimum and maximum combinations of weight and sling/pendant length approved for service. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle is capable of jettisoning external loads without loss of control or incurring damage to the air vehicle for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. External loadings should include the minimum and maximum combinations of weight and sling/pendant length approved for service.
